items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Man, I was in Germany with Wild Bill Davison, the old cornet player

ctx.x: And talk about education, you’re never quitting, you’re still—

Man, I was in Germany with Wild Bill Davison, the old cornet player, and man he had his little audiotape that he — and by this time he was about 387 years old, I mean this guy was old, but he had this little walkman and he put his tape on, put his cup mute in and got ready for the gig. Well I think I’ve watched people who have survived — well some people don’t, Jane Jarvis doesn’t have to practice. That’s amazing. Well I guess she does — she keeps loosened up, but it comes easier for some people than others. I…
He seems like a very spiritual person, reading his liner notes and so forth.
